verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Pendo serves an llms.txt at developers.pendo.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so a user can point an agent at it. However, its sampled content reads as key terms and product-overview descriptions (Predict, Validate) rather than deep, agent-oriented technical docs. Missing for 10: markdown versions of doc pages (the .md probe returned 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), evidence of substantive developer or API content in llms.txt, and independent corroboration of agent use.
